summary: Iteration 160 — Full dashboard demo data verification. Backend: 34/36 tests pass (2 minor invoice amount discrepancies in test assertions, not actual app bugs). Frontend: All 4 stat widgets, overdue banner, quick actions, nav links, order pricing, team/employees, invoices, webstores all verified via Playwright. integration_issues.issue: Shows 'No jobs due today' even though 6 demo appointments were created for 2026-05-21. Root cause: appointments were created without scheduled_date/scheduled_start fields (all null), so /api/productivity/items?start_date=today returns 0 appointment items. The productivity system has these 12 appointments (6×2 duplicates) but they have no datetime to match 'today'.

Shows '0 in, 0 scheduled' and 'No employees scheduled or clocked in today'. Employees exist (4 demo × 2 duplicates = 8 in DB) but none are scheduled for today and Gabe is not clocked in as originally intended.

appointments_root_cause_analysis.symptom: Dashboard 'Today's Schedule' shows 'No jobs due today' despite 6 appointments created for 2026-05-21
appointments_root_cause_analysis.root_cause: Demo appointments were created via POST /api/appointments with 'date': '2026-05-21' in the payload, but the API field is 'scheduled_date' (or 'scheduled_start'/'scheduled_at'). All 6 appointments have scheduled_date=null, scheduled_start=null, scheduled_end=null, scheduled_at=null in the DB. The productivity/items API filters by start_datetime/due_datetime, so date-filtered queries return 0 results.
appointments_root_cause_analysis.additional_issue: Demo script created each appointment TWICE (12 total demo appointments instead of 6, all with null dates)
appointments_root_cause_analysis.fix_needed: Update 6 demo appointments to set scheduled_date='2026-05-21' and scheduled_start with specific times (9:00am, 10:00am, etc.)

employee_duplicate_root_cause.symptom: Team Status shows 0 in/scheduled; Payroll shows each demo employee twice
employee_duplicate_root_cause.root_cause: Demo script ran the employee creation code twice, creating 8 employees (4 DEMO names × 2 IDs each). Both sets are visible in /api/employees response and /api/dashboard/team-status-today.
employee_duplicate_root_cause.fix_needed: Delete 4 duplicate employee records (one of each DEMO employee name)

critical_code_review_comments: Dashboard.js line 656-674: Schedule widget fetches from /api/productivity/items with item_types=appointment. This is correct but requires appointments to have start_datetime set. The /api/appointments collection has a separate date model (scheduled_date/scheduled_start) that may not sync automatically to productivity/items start_datetime.

TeamStatusWidget (Dashboard.js line 194): Relies on /api/dashboard/team-status-today. This endpoint returns duplicate employee entries when duplicate employee records exist in DB — no deduplication by name.
PendingApprovalsWidget links go to /jobs/{job_id} which redirects to /productivity/legacy-jobs/{id} — this path works but may generate 404 API errors on the legacy redirect page.

The appointments collection uses scheduled_date/scheduled_start/scheduled_at fields but productivity/items uses start_datetime/due_datetime — ensure the productivity indexer maps appointments correctly.
Invoice amounts stored in DB ($40 ABC, $252 Mountain View) differ from demo_data_report.json expected values ($42.40 and $267.12). These may reflect actual pricing without tax/fees.

rca_of_the_issue: Main RCA: Demo script used 'date' as the field name when creating appointments (POST /api/appointments), but the correct field is 'scheduled_date' (or 'scheduled_start'/'scheduled_at'). All 6 demo appointments were saved with all datetime fields as null. Additionally the demo script ran twice creating duplicates of appointments (12 instead of 6) and employees (8 instead of 4). The fix is: 1) PATCH the 6 demo appointments to add scheduled_date/scheduled_start/scheduled_end. 2) Delete the 6 duplicate appointments. 3) Delete 4 duplicate employee records. 4) Update the Johnson event store with event fields.
